# Support

Read the [README](../README.md) and the [setup guide](../docs/development/setup.md) before you open a question. [tests/README.md](../tests/README.md) explains the test projects.

Open a GitHub issue for a setup question, a reproducible defect, or a feature request. Include the SDK version, operating system, command, and error output, and remove credentials and personal data from logs.

Report vulnerabilities through [the security policy](SECURITY.md). Raise conduct concerns through the private contact in [the code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

The maintainer works on this portfolio project alongside other work and offers no response-time commitment.
